items.title: Warren Buffett’s Berkshire Is Buying These 2 Homebuilding Stocks. Housing Market Recovery Coming?
items.summary: Warren Buffett’s Berkshire Hathaway, which is now run by Greg Abel, revealed in its latest 13F filing that the fund bought a new stake in D.R. Horton (NYSE:DHI), worth about $580,000. The fund also increased its stake in fellow homebuilder Lennar (NYSE:LEN) by 30% in the second quarter, lifting that position to about $1.2 billion. […]

items.title: Did Berkshire Hathaway’s $6.8 Billion Bet Misjudge the Housing Market — Again?
items.summary: Greg Abel just committed $6.8 billion to homebuilders while mortgage rates hover near 7% and builder sentiment sits at multi-year lows. Whether that looks like bold contrarian conviction or a costly miscalculation depends on what happens next.

items.title: The Fed Held Rates Flat for 231 Days, Your Mortgage Rates Went Up Anyway
items.summary: The Federal Reserve has not touched interest rates in over seven months, yet mortgage rates just climbed to their highest level in years. Understanding why exposes a flaw in how most borrowers think about the connection between the Fed and their monthly payment.

items.title: 3 Reasons to Sell DHI and 1 Stock to Buy Instead
items.summary: Over the past six months, D.R. Horton’s shares (currently trading at $148.52) have posted a disappointing 11.2% loss, well below the S&P 500’s 13.1% gain. This was partly due to its softer quarterly results and may have investors wondering how to approach the situation.

items.title: Berkshire Reshapes Its Stock Portfolio: ETFs in Focus
items.summary: Berkshire's latest portfolio moves signal a bigger bet on Alphabet and housing stocks. Here are the ETFs that offer exposure to its top buys.

items.title: Greg Abel Just Bet $17 Billion on This 1 Stock
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway's new CEO just made the firm's biggest single-quarter bet in years, and the stock he chose reveals exactly how he plans to run the empire differently than Buffett did.

items.summary: Index removal puts fresh attention on D.R. Horton stock D.R. Horton (DHI) has been removed from the Philippines All Share Index, a change that can affect how some passive funds and benchmark-aware investors treat the stock in international portfolios. items.title: Warren Buffett Wasn’t the Only Billionaire Buying Alphabet Stock in Q2
items.summary: Every August, 13F filings crack open the vaults of the world's biggest money managers, and this quarter two billionaires with almost nothing in common landed on the exact same stock.
